neighbours.label: The speaker's ' would' or ''d' (subject I or we) right after an 'if you / if anyone ...' clause about something the reader might do, in a polite request or offer to the reader (the 'if you have X, I would appreciate it / we'd be happy to Y' closing); also the ' I' in 'correct me if I'm wrong / mistaken', and more weakly (about 0.3) phrasal 'come in' ('that's where X comes in', 'come in handy'). Quiet: 'would' after the speaker's own condition ('if I had money, I would...'), habitual or past 'would', 'would' with no 'if' clause, third-person subjects (he, they, my sister) in the same frame, and plain 'will be' / 'would have been'.
neighbours.short: I/we 'would' after 'if you/anyone...' (polite ask or offer to the reader)
fire: If you have any spare copies of the manual, I would really appreciate it if you could send one over.
If anyone knows a good plumber in the area, I'd be grateful for a recommendation.
If you have any questions about your order, we would be happy to help.
Correct me if I'm wrong, but the meeting was moved to Thursday.
If you could take a quick look at the draft before Friday, I would be very thankful.
If anyone is interested in joining the hiking group, we'd love to have you.
The deadline was last week, correct me if I'm mistaken.
quiet: So, we can say that manual is the best reference when we want to understand the digital camera product.
If I had more money, I would buy a bigger house by the lake.
When we were kids, we would spend every summer at our grandmother's farm.
I would really appreciate some quiet time this weekend.
If you have any questions about the order, she would be happy to help.
If you need a ride to the airport, my brother would be glad to drive you.
I think the meeting was moved to Thursday, but I'm not completely sure.
If anyone is interested in joining the hiking group, they will be welcome.

predictions: Blind test written from the label only. Expect the 'if you/anyone ..., I/we would' fire items around 0.3-0.6 and 'come in' around 0.3; risk: 'Correct me if I'm wrong' sentence-initial may score lower.
notes: Step-in reader of bonsai1/L33/N4153+ (drop 0.74 in play step --down). Feeders-first experiment arm: the 12 strongest MLP feeders (L26/N5408-, L23/N1430+, L24/N6328-, ...) were all unlabelled, so they did not shape the label. Output direction promotes ' be'/' been'/' being' on this pole.
